name: 左轮手枪
description: 弹射物。选择正方向，生成随自身移动的6格射击区域，持续2全局回合。每全局回合结束时，对区域内首个敌人造成1倍伤害。与【子弹风暴】互斥。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,p=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:6,filter:'all'});if(!p||p.needsTargetSelection)return p;var dx=Math.sign(p.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(p.y-c.y);if((dx===0&&dy===0)||(dx!==0&&dy!==0))return{success:false,message:'请选择施法者以外的方向格'};if(!battle.extensions)battle.extensions={};if(!battle.extensions.coltZones)battle.extensions.coltZones={};battle.extensions.coltZones[c.instanceId]={sourceId:c.instanceId,kind:'revolver',dx:dx,dy:dy,turns:2};var zoneId='colt-zone-'+c.instanceId;removeStatusEffectById(c.instanceId,zoneId);addStatusEffectById(c.instanceId,{id:zoneId,type:'colt-zone',name:'左轮射击区域',description:'随施法者位置移动；与子弹风暴互斥。',currentDuration:-1,currentUses:-1,stacks:2,intensity:2});return{success:true,message:c.name+'布置左轮手枪射击区域（随自身移动，持续2回合）'};}
